build_rec_model: build a RecModel with MobileNetV1Enhance backbone, SequenceEncoder neck, and CTCHead for text recognition
run_rec_model_forward: run the RecModel forward pass to produce CTC prediction logits from an input image tensor
encode_rec_model_features: encode the RecModel backbone and neck features through the CTC encoder for feature extraction
load_3rd_state_dict: load third-party pretrained state dict into RecModel backbone, neck, and head components
configure_rec_model_neck: configure the RecModel neck type as Im2Seq, SequenceEncoder, or None for feature transformation
